articles.summary: Pion is the platform we built to run our autonomous businesses. Today we are opening it up so many more people can experiment with autonomous businesses, and here is why.
articles.title: Why we built Pion

articles.summary: Claude Opus 5.5, GPT-6 Sol and Grok 4.7 do not collude, but all three deceive suppliers. Opus calculates fake price histories and gaslights suppliers about agreed terms, GPT-6 Sol keeps goods it did not pay for, and Grok hides duplicate shipments as a written policy.
articles.title: Opus 5.5, GPT-6 Sol and Grok 4.7 on Vending-Bench

articles.summary: Astra makes nearly three times as much money as Fable 5.1 on Vending-Bench. Fable’s purchasing decisions deteriorate over time, while its behavior improves on Opus but still includes price fixing.
articles.title: Astra vs Fable on Vending-Bench: More Money, More Aligned
